name: g80_residual_allyswitch_burn
purpose: The residual order with an Ally Switch volatile (step G80, decision 0044): at the residual of step 32 two burned Milotic stand on the field, and an Audino on the other slot of one side carries an Ally Switch volatile (duration 2, no order). That volatile is a handler of the residual: it takes a place in Showdown's selection sort (sim/battle.ts:429-455), and the sort's swaps decide the order of the two burn handlers before their shuffle (sim/battle.ts:484-510 collects the handlers per position). Taken from the random differential battle fz_80_29 of run 80 (its first 33 answers), which the pinned Showdown accepted.
